speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me exactly when you first noticed the unsteadiness in your walking and arms, and if it has been getting worse over time? Also, have you experienced any recent episodes of vertigo, slurred speech, or double vision?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of diabetes, high cholesterol, or high blood pressure, and have you experienced any sudden severe headaches or visual changes alongside this weakness? I need to know if you've had any recent fevers or infections that might suggest an inflammatory cause.

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and recent use of natalizumab, have you noticed any other neurological symptoms like numbness, tingling, or vision changes? Do you recall if this ataxia started gradually or appeared suddenly after your last infusion?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had a recent fever or major infection that I know of. The symptoms are mostly gait imbalance, limb ataxia, and weaker use of my right arm.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and treatment with natalizumab, have you noticed any new or worsening visual changes, cognitive difficulties, or memory loss alongside your balance issues? I need to rule out a specific infection associated with your medication, so I will request an MRI of your brain to look for characteristic lesions. REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Brain Findings: Lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML). Comments: T1/T2 images showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of PML. Neurological Examination: Ataxic gait noted; Right Upper Limb Strength 4/5; Evidence of ataxia in coordination tests. Vital Signs: Normothermic; Blood Pressure, Heart Rate, and Respiratory Rate within normal range.

speaker: Doctor
text: The MRI findings are definitive for Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML) given your history of natalizumab use.
